sourceOfTruth: The PR head code and GitHub Actions run reports, not this file alone.

globeIntegration.approach: On unlocked globe location information, a lazy-loaded researched country article can be opened inline; a separate link deep-opens that country in the 218-feature library.
globeIntegration.safeLimitations: Bridge is read-only and does not replace location purchase/equip logic. Existing historical paid destinations remain 161 IDs; the 196 country articles are NOT 196 newly purchasable locations.
unusualGeographies: TW and PF are explicitly outside the 196 country gateway archive, although their existing location pins remain supported.

photoIntegration.reader: Up to three verified CC images for an article, with visible named author, original Wikimedia file link and licence link.
photoIntegration.unlockedGlobe: Up to two verified CC images when the article country has a reviewed photo record.
photoIntegration.noPhotoCopyrightAssertionForExistingCode: Original app.js auto-searches Wikimedia photos without the same visible per-image attribution. That code is not modified and must be audited before release.
photoIntegration.limitations: No image binaries bundled. Special:FilePath redirection, device display, licence changes and availability need real-browser checks.

profileAndEconomy.currentStatus: Pure module exists and is tested, but is NOT called by production app.js.
profileAndEconomy.criticalRisk: Existing app.js ensureProfile still resets points and lifetimeXp when economyVersion != 2 and filters unknown purchased item IDs. Existing app.js buy can double-charge when buying an alias under a different historical location ID.
profileAndEconomy.requiredBeforeMerge: Reconcile PR #1 app.js changes, wire safeRulesModule into actual profile migration and buy/gallery/globe paths, back up user data, and run real old-profile tests and device tests.

publish: DO NOT merge PR #2 until production profile/economy blockers and image/browser checks are resolved.
